bugs.title: decode(encode(x)) drops trailing whitespace in values
bugs.root_cause: decode() calls .strip() on every value, but encode() never escapes whitespace.
bugs.patch_diff:
--- a/src/fakelib/codec.py
+++ b/src/fakelib/codec.py
@@ -41,7 +41,7 @@ def decode(data: str) -> dict:
-    key, _, value = line.partition("=")
+    key, _, value = line.partition("=")  # keep '=' inside values
-    return {k: v.strip() for k, v in pairs}
+    return {k: v for k, v in pairs}

bugs.title: parse_range crashes with IndexError on an empty string
bugs.traceback:
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "fakelib/ranges.py", line 12, in parse_range
    start = parts[0][0]
IndexError: string index out of range
bugs.root_cause: No guard for empty input before indexing the first character.
bugs.patch_diff:
--- a/src/fakelib/ranges.py
+++ b/src/fakelib/ranges.py
@@ -10,2 +10,4 @@
+    if not text:
+        raise ValueError("empty range")

bugs.title: merge() is not associative for overlapping keys
bugs.root_cause: Nested lists are appended instead of extended when the right side is already merged.
